sources: https://riverton.illinois.gov/Parks (read 2026-11-16): 'Wheeland Park - Nestled on the east bank of the historic Sangamon River, this park features 11 campsites with fire rings, gravel drives, picnic tables and lantern holders at each site. Some sites have electric which is available for $5 a night. Drinking water is available from a water fountain/spigot at the campground entrance. A boat ramp and sand volleyball court add to the parks amenities.' '235 3rd St, Riverton, IL 62561'

https://riverton.illinois.gov/Community-Information/Community-Contacts, /Community-Information/Village-Fees, /Contact (read 2026-11-16): no park or village-hall phone and no camping fee listed; contact is a web form

note: Village of Riverton park on the east bank of the Sangamon River just east of Springfield: gravel drives, fire rings and lantern holders; some sites have electric. Drinking water from a spigot at the campground entrance; boat ramp. Pad lengths are not published. --Claude
summary: Village parks page, fees and contacts pages read; imagery viewed. Facts confirmed: 11 sites, gravel drives, some electric at $5/night, spigot water, boat ramp. Restrooms/no-showers (stored from the village ordinance) not on the current page - left as stored. No phone published. Waterfront: stored not waterfront; imagery puts eight spurs 15-20 m from the river behind a thin tree line - proposes riverview.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront -> riverview proposed (reviewer). Leaf-off imagery: eight gravel back-in spurs on the river (west) side of the loop, centred about 39.8403,-89.5463, end about 15-20 m from the Sangamon River (55-60 m wide, so river not creek) across a grass strip and a thin line of bank trees/brush; no levee. The stored evidence's '~50 m ... behind a wooded bank' overstates the distance. A thin tree line makes it a view, not riverfront. No site numbers are published.
FIT: pad lengths not published; imagery spurs read about 15-18 m long. No caveat change.
FACILITIES: stored showers false came from the village camping ordinance; the current parks page no longer mentions restrooms. Left as stored.
PHONE: none -> none (no village hall or park phone on riverton.illinois.gov; contact is a web form; Google lists none). WEBSITE: https://riverton.illinois.gov/Parks current.
